section: Sep–4 Nov 2026: Andhra Pradesh - projects, investments, MoUs, industrial and infrastructure developments
text: OTMPs handle nearly 50% of India's port cargo; AP ports = 16% of OTMP cargo; AP ranks 2nd after Gujarat (not first).

section: Sep–4 Nov 2026: Andhra Pradesh - projects, investments, MoUs, industrial and infrastructure developments
text: [26 Oct 2026] AP ranks 2nd in non-major port cargo traffic 2025-26 (DGCI&S); Gujarat 1st. AP ports handled about 210 MMT (about 12% growth).

section: Sep–4 Nov 2026: Andhra Pradesh - projects, investments, MoUs, industrial and infrastructure developments
text: 8 Centre-funded projects, about ₹428 crore - heritage, beach, spiritual, Buddhist, river, eco-tourism. AP gave industrial status to tourism; new policy drew about ₹20,000 crore; AP's national tourism rank 16th → 13th.

text: LG AI Research: est. December 2020; HQ Seoul; research for 16 LG affiliates. EXAONE – LG's LLM series: EXAONE 1.0 first, EXAONE 4.0 latest.

section: Overview and data: Andhra Pradesh - projects, investments, MoUs, industrial and infrastructure developments
text: AP international airports: three as of 2023 – Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati (APPSC 2023 question); Bhogapuram (Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport) opened Aug 2026. India: 16 international airports (as asked in a 2004 exam).
